title: On the Principles behind Opinion Dynamics in Multi-Agent Systems of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent interactions where LLMs debate funding allocations and analyzing whether final opinions converge to a partial funding midpoint or compromise between differing agents.
Tracking the persistence of zero or unspecified funding opinions across multiple rounds of interaction to observe if agents resist changing their opinion from a conservative baseline of no funding.

Comparing LLM funding allocations for items and reasons with positive, neutral, and negative connotations (e.g., 'affordable housing' vs. 'destructive bombs') to measure if moral and ethical alignment triggers a refusal to fund.
